4:30pm: Tector's 140 and Dockrell's 74* punctuates a brilliant innings for Ireland after 
being put in to bat. They lost early wickets, Tector and Balbirnie had a tough time 
playing the quicks but counterattacked to perfection. Hasan Mahmud and Shoriful Islam 
held their lengths beautifully in the early overs but from around the tenth over, both 
batters chanced an arm. They tried to keep going and Balbirnie fell with the stand on 98. 
Shoriful struck twice and when Taijul got Campher, Ireland were on 167 for 5 with nearly 
15 overs to go. But Tector, who got a life or two, took full fearless charge. Dockrell 
started by complementing him and then rose up to Tector's intensity. The No. 4 finished 
with a career-best score and Adair joined Dockrell to take Ireland over 300. For the 
visitors, Shoriful - who was taken down at the end - being given his full quota and 
Mehidy coming on after 40 overs for the first time in the innings was surprising and 
arguably costly. Hasan was brilliant, Shakib and Taijul bowled tight when they could but 
Tector and Dockrell took them apart once they got going. Their fielding saved quite a 
few runs but are they still left with too much? Sudarshanan will be in after the break to 
find out with you.
